scope: Six selected library profiles; source files measured without filesystem block overhead. .a are unstripped GCC MinSizeRel output, not source sizes or total RAM. Matio zlib and HDF5 dependencies are reused and are not included in matio .a.
retention: Production C sources, headers, platform branches and required build/configuration templates
Source-only upstream tests/examples; binary corpora, generated reports and artifacts excluded
libxls 35840-byte upstream XLS fixture represented as C99 array in tests/xls_fixture.inc; original binary not shipped
removed: Download archives and duplicate source distributions
Generated configure scripts, unused build systems, CI and package-manager integrations
PDF/site assets, large changelogs and prebuilt HTML documentation
Upstream binary test datasets and expected-output corpora
Matio GPL autotools support scripts; production retained files remain permissive
General-purpose Lua/Wren/Duktape runtimes excluded by user direction
measurement_note: Isolated group MinSizeRel measurements; TIFF includes zlib Deflate/AdobeDeflate. Whole-collection archive sizes may differ with inherited compile definitions/PIC and are reported in docs/c99_archive/SIZES.json. Matio MAT73 follow-up measured independently on 2026-11-26; see MAT73_INTEGRATION.json.
